what: a G1 blend bridging a 10 mm step between two parallel sheets (z = 0 and z = 10), stitched to both: it meets each at G1
method: sheets x 0..10 at z = 0 and x 20..30 at z = 10, 20 wide; the blend leaves each edge in its sheet's tangent plane (and curvature, rate) as asked. Graded: the order at both seams as Continuity Analysis measures it, one body of 3 faces (each a different surface, so none merge)
